mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.8% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.8%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate and a rise in retail sales (RSAFS) signals a strong labor market and robust consumer spending, which together drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining UNRATE and rising RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime characterized by high consumer spending, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1,150,000 units signals weakening demand for housing and a potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during late-cycle expansion when HOUST falls below 1,150,000.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 115.0 for two consecutive months indicates strong manufacturing activity, which supports corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 115.0 for two months.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.5%, it signals persistent inflation that may trigger a monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-recession recovery regime, a decline in the real sales of retail and food services (RSAFS) below 375,000 million dollars signals weak consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during post-recession recovery when RSAFS falls below 375,000.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% and a decline in employment (PAYEMS) below 138,000 thousand signals a tightening monetary policy combined with labor market weakness, which together drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and PAYEMS < 138,000 fails to produce negative 5-day returns in more than 55% of cases.
